tags.gist: Supports a risk-based lifecycle approach built on established device principles.
Would use the two axes only as a screening tool, not a classification matrix, with device-level risk analysis covering error recognition, intervention, reversibility and safeguards.
Opposes presuming higher risk for patient-facing use and suggests adaptive communication keyed to demonstrated user understanding as a possible risk control.
Supports proportionate confirmation driven by the residual uncertainty after benchmarking, with the methods treated as complementary options rather than a fixed hierarchy.
Wants third-party models handled like software of unknown provenance under IEC 62304, with change notification, version control, regression benchmarking and behavioral monitoring.
Says GenAI's new failure mechanisms do not require replacing established risk-based principles focused on intended use and residual risk.
